name: GTA (Guam)
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public gta.net help center articles only (no sign-in). GTA (TeleGuam) is the incumbent landline carrier for Guam; postpaid home phone, internet and TV bill through the myGTA web portal (ebill.gta.net, formerly GTA E-Pay). Registration: Register here > Invoice Number and Amount Due from the latest statement (not expressible; accountNumber is modelled) > CAPTCHA > email address, password, security question > confirm via email link; sign-in uses the email address as the eBill username (Forgot Your Password? asks for the email username and the security answer). myGTA: Overview (balance, pending payments, amount due), Invoices (PDF/CSV), Pay (one-time or scheduled, choose amount and date), Auto Pay (recurring on the scheduled date; add a method, accept terms), saved credit/debit cards and bank accounts, Payment History. No online payment fee is published (none charged). Phone payments: Customer Support Center 671-644-4482 (8 am-9 pm for payments) with account number and card or bank details; LiveChat/WhatsApp 671-489-8255. In person at four GTA stores (Tamuning Experience Center, Micronesia Mall, Andersen AFB BX, NEX). No mailing address is published. A pay-without-signing-in page is not described (family default kept). Paperless: Settings > General > Invoice Preferences > Web bill only; printed bills cost $3.00 a month, but landline-only and Lifeline customers are exempt (so the fee is in help only). Due within 30 days of the bill date; past-due balances must be paid by the 15th to avoid disconnection; late fee 1.5% of the amount owed for landline-only service (flat $10.00 for bundles or standalone data/TV; the engine uses the landline 1.5%); returned payments $26; suspension, then termination after 45 days unpaid. Payment Arrangement Plan (extended periods, late fees waived during the plan) via the Customer Support Center, a store or chat. Adding or removing services is done with a GTA representative (phone, store, chat, email), not self-service online. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (t20 review): GTA's own pages disagree on the LiveChat/WhatsApp number (671-489-8255 on the pay and phone-payment pages, 671-489-8225 on the add/remove-service page); the service-change texts now omit it and the payment help keeps 671-489-8255 (two pages agree). The Payment Arrangement Plan text comes from the phone-payment page.

help.title: How to pay my GTA bill
paragraphs: Log in to myGTA to pay online. Overview shows your balance, pending payments and due date. Choose Pay to make a one-time or scheduled payment with a saved or new credit/debit card or bank account, or set up Auto Pay.

By phone, call the Customer Support Center at 671-644-4482 (payments 8 am to 9 pm daily) with your account number and card or bank details, and ask for a confirmation number. LiveChat and WhatsApp are at 671-489-8255.
In person, pay at the GTA Experience Center in Tamuning, Micronesia Mall in Dededo, the Andersen Air Force Base BX or the NEX.

help.title: Late payments
paragraphs: Payment is due within 30 days of the bill date. Past-due balances must be paid in full by the 15th of the month to avoid disconnection.

Late fee: 1.5% of the total owed for landline-only service, or a flat $10.00 for bundles and standalone data or TV. Returned payments cost $26. A suspended account is terminated if nothing is paid within 45 days, and restoring service requires all charges, late fees and reconnection fees.
The Payment Arrangement Plan offers extended payment periods with late fees waived during the plan. Ask the Customer Support Center at 671-644-4482, a GTA store or LiveChat.

help.title: Auto Pay in myGTA
paragraphs: In myGTA, open Auto Pay, add a credit/debit card or bank account, accept the Terms and Conditions and submit. Payments are then deducted automatically on the scheduled date, which helps you avoid late fees.

help.title: Go paperless
paragraphs: Log in to myGTA, go to Settings, then General, change your Invoice Preferences and select Web bill only.
Printed bills cost $3.00 a month. Landline-only and Lifeline customers are exempt from this fee.

help.title: Register for myGTA
paragraphs: Have your latest statement ready. Select Register here, enter the Invoice Number and Amount Due, complete the robot check and continue. Enter your email address, a password and a security question, then select Register and confirm with the link emailed to you.
Forgot your password? Choose Forgot Your Password?, enter your email username and answer your security question to get a temporary password.

help.title: Add or remove a service
paragraphs: Services are added or removed with a GTA representative. Call 671-644-4482 (6 AM to 12 AM daily), use LiveChat or WhatsApp, email ask@gta.net, or visit a GTA store.
Have your account number, the account holder's name, the phone number on the account and your 4-digit PIN or password ready.
